text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt rewarding, but a realized gain is not a reason by itself to sell; I should judge each position by its risk and future prospects.","After buying more of all five stocks in Period 7, my account continued to fall. I should not treat lower prices as proof that a stock is a bargain; with unpredictable prices, I need to size holdings around risk and diversification.","I sold Stock C at a loss while mostly holding through large account declines. I should avoid letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate decisions, and review my portfolio consistently even though I trade infrequently."]}
